Question Choices: Select which formula finds the volume of a rectangular prism? ~~2x(LengthxWidth) | Length+Width+Height | LengthxWidthxHeight~~
Solution: A base layer contains length×width unit cubes. Stacking height layers gives volume=length×width×height. Adding lengths does not give volume; twice the base area also omits height.

Question Choices: One cube measures 2 cm × 2 cm × 2 cm. What is the volume of this cube in cubic centimeter (cm³)?
Hints: A cube has three equal dimensions; multiply its side length three times.
Solution: Base area = 2 × 2 = 4 square centimeters. Volume = base area × height = 4 × 2 = 8 cubic centimeters.

Question Choices: When length is measured in meters, volume is measured in __
Solution: Multiplying three lengths in metres gives metres×metres×metres=cubic metres (m³).

Question Choices: Fill: A rectangular prism is 2 feet long, 3 feet wide and 4 feet high. The volume is __ cubic feet (ft³)
Hints: Multiply length, width and height, using the same length unit.
Solution: Base area = 2 × 3 = 6 square feet. Volume = base area × height = 6 × 4 = 24 cubic feet.

Question Choices: A rectangular prism has a base area of 9 cm² and a height of 3 cm. Its volume is __ cubic centimeters (cm³).
Hints: The base area already equals length times width. Multiply it by height.
Solution: The given base area already includes length × width. Volume = 9 cm² × 3 cm = 27 cm³.

Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "To find the volume of a rectangular prism, you only need to know two dimensions." ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Solution: For a general rectangular prism, two side lengths alone do not determine the third. Volume=length×width×height requires all three dimensions, or the equivalent base area and perpendicular height. Thus the statement is FALSE.

Question Choices: Select which of the following gives the same volume? ~~8x5x7 | 7x5x8 | 5x7x8 | All-of-the-above~~
Solution: 8×5×7=280;7×5×8=280;5×7×8=280. Each uses the same three factors once; multiplication order does not change the volume.

Question Choices: Fill: A box is measured as 6 m long, 4 m wide and 5 m high. The volume is __ cubic meters (m³)
Hints: Multiply length, width and height, using the same length unit.
Solution: Base area = 6 × 4 = 24 square meters. Volume = base area × height = 24 × 5 = 120 cubic meters.

Question Choices: Fill: A fish tank is 12 m long, 4 m wide and 6 m high. The volume of the fish tank is __ cubic meters (m³)
Hints: Multiply length, width and height, using the same length unit.
Solution: Base area = 12 × 4 = 48 square meters. Volume = base area × height = 48 × 6 = 288 cubic meters.

Question Choices: Fill: A box has a volume of 60 cm³. Its length is 3 cm and width is 2 cm. The height is __ cm.
Hints: Divide the volume by the base area to find height.
Solution: Base area = 3 × 2 = 6 cm². Height = volume ÷ base area = 60 ÷ 6 = 10 cm. Check: 3 × 2 × 10 = 60 cm³.
